description: Sandbox only. Acts as the principal paying a get_topup_link URL: the mock provider sends a PayPlus-format IPN through the same webhook path production uses, and the wallet is credited. outcome "declined" simulates a failed card.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

outcome.description: approved (default) credits the wallet; declined simulates a failed card

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)
